kon.name: Money Montgomery - Fluid Engaging Real Storyteller Performer

lines.say: [screaming] AAH! SNAKE! SNAKE!
[amused] That little thing? Want to hear about one with eight heads?
[shocked] EIGHT?!
[storytelling] Susanoo was the god of storms. Wild, loud, and so destructive, the other gods threw him out of heaven.
cap: the other gods {r:threw him out} of heaven.

lines.say: He landed by a river in Izumo, and saw chopsticks floating downstream.
cap: He landed by a river in {g:Izumo},

lines.say: [curious] So someone lives up there!
Upstream, he found an old couple, crying beside their daughter.
cap: Upstream, he found an old couple,

lines.say: [gruff] Why do you weep?
[weeping] We had eight daughters. Every year, the serpent Orochi comes, and eats one. Now it comes for our last.
What does it look like?
[fearful] Eight heads. Eight tails. Eyes red as winter cherries. Trees grow on its back, and it stretches over eight valleys and eight hills.
cap: and it stretches over {o:eight valleys} and {o:eight hills}.”

lines.say: [horrified] Nope. Absolutely not.
[confident] Give me your daughter's hand, and I will kill it.
Then he did something strange. He turned the girl, Kushinada, into a comb, and wore her in his hair.
cap: and wore her in his hair.

lines.say: [confused] He turned her into a COMB?!
[smug] Safest place in Izumo.
He ordered the strongest saké ever brewed. A fence with eight gates. And behind every gate, a vat.
cap: He ordered the {o:strongest sake} ever brewed.

lines.say: [ominous] That night, the mountains moved.
Eight heads came through eight gates, and each one found the saké.
[whispering] It drank, and drank, until all eight heads fell asleep.
[whispering] Oh no. He's gonna...
[roaring] NOW!
[intense] Susanoo drew his sword, and cut the serpent to pieces. The river ran red.
But when he struck the middle tail, his sword chipped.
cap: But when he struck the {o:middle tail},

lines.say: [confused] On a tail?
[awed] Inside the tail was another sword. The blade later named Kusanagi.
He gave it to his sister, the sun goddess Amaterasu. Today it's one of the three sacred treasures of Japan's emperors.
cap: He gave it to his sister,
Today it's one of the {o:three sacred treasures}

lines.say: [warmly] And Kushinada? Back to herself, and married to the storm.
[proud] Okay. Little snakes don't scare me anymo- AAH!
cap: Okay. Little snakes don't scare me
